advisory_notice: All SQA findings, rankings and assessments are recommendations. Master decides whether, when and how to act through docs/plan.json.
priority_assessment: The committed plan has no implementation rows. I would keep SQA-519 first: the active MOSS training proof fails at admission on unchanged fixtures, and the existing trainer can verify the replacement recipe once. I would take SQA-520 next so the MOSS timing check can distinguish a slower draw from a bad estimate. The six-section workflow check passed in the same run.

Before repeating the GPU checks, I would check how much card memory is available to their processes. Of the first 13 failed tests at efa59bd59, 11 reported insufficient device capacity and together ran for about 15 min 41 s. The other two need separate readings: SenseNova took 214.197 s against its 206.010 s reference, and the MOSS timing check rejected a negative estimate after all five draws finished. These failures do not give a comparable new MOSS workflow time.

findings.input: Run validation with the November 25 active MOSS training recipe 0349b5a91a74 and its unchanged two-picture fixture after the dataset identity change in bae839d75. Its stored flow-matching objective d160cb7afb6b names the manifest-only dataset 22d7d57a34bc. PictureManifest now identifies the same fixture, including its pictures, as 40d43e8337e2.
findings.expected: Keep the old recipe and its evidence bound to their original inputs. Use the existing MOSS trainer and verification/activation path to establish the recipe for the media-bound dataset once, then select that recipe for subsequent proofs. Until it is available, identify the affected MOSS recipe and the recovery needed at admission.
findings.actual: At efa59bd59 preflight refused one of 105 cells with no training route or objective alias. Its label, diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors training-proof, also appeared on a successful Wan proof. The November 25 scorecard and proof transcript identify both models; the stored MOSS recipe and objective confirm the old digest. groundTraining looks up only the current dataset identity and has no alias fallback for flow matching. trainingRun therefore stops before the MOSS trainer can bootstrap the replacement. Retrying with the same active recipe gives the same refusal. The changed identity is intentional; the missing transition leaves a previously runnable proof stranded.

findings.input: Run TestWhereAMossStepsTimeGoes at the Ultra text section's 2368 by 1344 size. After warm-up it draws separate 2-, 4- and 6-step guided requests and a 6-step conditional request. If the 6-step guided wall exceeds three times the 2-step wall, the estimated setup time is negative even when every draw succeeds.
findings.expected: Compare elapsed time between completed steps in one draw with the corresponding ComfyUI progress interval. The sampler already reports step completion through processmeasure.Stepped. Keep the host-transfer and launch counts and the independent output and whole-workflow checks. Report setup or pass overhead only when measured at its own boundaries. The 2- and 4-step draws used solely to fit and cross-check the estimate can then go.
findings.actual: At efa59bd59 all five draws finished, but the check failed after 2 min 10 s. It reported -717 ms of request setup and -497 ms beside the two passes of a guided step. TestWhereAMossStepsTimeGoes obtains the guided step by subtracting the walls of separate 6- and 2-step requests and dividing by four, then subtracts two such steps from the 2-step wall. Its strict positive-setup assertion fails on that estimate before its 4-step check runs. The recorded ComfyUI step uses elapsed time between progress events in one request.

SQA-519.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-27 at be3e42bb3: valid, observed (the preflight at efa59bd59 refused MOSS's training-proof cell; the lead had traced it to training-identity/do's new identity before the finding, memory lessons). Filed as moss-recipe-current: do names a stranded proof's recipe, dataset and recovery at admission; activate runs the MOSS route once on the card, after the measurement run, which establishes the recipe over the media-bound dataset through the existing trainer, first of the rows.

SQA-520.note: Answered by the lead on 2026-11-27 at be3e42bb3: valid, observed (the models lane failed TestWhereAMossStepsTimeGoes at efa59bd59 on a -717 ms request part, its draws beside another process on the card, which widened the spread the estimate cannot bear). A failed lane ends the cycle before its cells, so it costs measured time. Filed as moss-step-time/draw: a step and a pass read between completed steps of one draw (processmeasure.WithSteps).
